notes.title: Update 1.3 is now available!
notes.content:
Hi, dear friends!

Not so long time ago we've reduced the price and today we release new update! Fixed some bugs and significantly changed the game.

Changes:
Updated explosion effect of spaceship
Updated explosion effect of planet
Updated trail effect from spaceship
Updated rocket trail and explosion effects
Updated laser and plasma effects
Updated space fog effect

Improvements:
Improved and supplemented the system of shots

Fixes:
Fixed shots from turrets
Fixed game crash
Different small fixes and improvements

BIG thanks for your reviews and suggestions! We really need to know your opinion about the game to improve this and we are on the right way thanks to you.

Have a good game!

notes.title: Update 1.2 is now available!
notes.content:
Hi, dear friends!

Today we released updates, which took into account many of your wishes. Fixed many bugs and significantly changed the game.

Changes:

Added checkpoints to the last levels
Rebalanced levels with corridors
Changed order levels
Changed position of the robot in ships
Changed player death


Improvements:

Improved and supplemented the system of shots


Fixes:

Fixed a bug with flying into the planet
Fixed bug with level completion with corridors
Fixed the final scene at the end of the game
Fixed bug with black screen
Fixed bugs with sounds


Big thanks, dear friends, for your reviews and comments! We really need to know your opinion about the game to improve this and we are on the right way thanks to you.

Have a good game!

notes.title: Update 1.1 is now available!
notes.content:
Hi, dear friends!

Today we have a new update of AI Rebellion for you! According to reviews we’ve got we made some changes at our game. 

Improvements:

Update english localization in game
Add hint for second weapon in level 6
Add sound effect for levers in cabines


Main Changes:

Rebelance enemies in level 3, 5 and 7
Rebalance level 5
Update display timer in level 10
Fix rockets (they attacked us)


Last Fixes:

Fix problem with start dialogue in level 6 after death
Fix all units on start level 6 after death player
Sound blocked in menu now is not playing
Fix problem with hint in cruiser
After destroy planet in level 10 timer is disabled
Fixed absence some sound in levels 9, 10


Big thanks, dear friends, for your reviews and comments! We really need to know your opinion about the game to improve this and we are on the right way thanks to you.

Best regards, Immergity Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi, dear friends!

Today we have a new update of AI Rebellion for you! According to reviews we’ve got we made some changes at our game. 

Some Improvements:

German version of localization was improved
Some scenes became more understandable by adding a tutorial in them


Main Changes:

According to review of Solrac Invictus were updated volume options - there were added separate sliders for a music and voice
Fighters were rebalanced in some scenes to make them some easier
Last levels were rebalanced to make them easier
Too long dialogues were improved by making them shorter
Tutorial scene was updated
Scheme control on HTC Vive was updated according to emacsen message (now you can just click on button on the side of controller instead of holding this)



Last Fixes:

Fixed problem with volume sounds in scenes after tutorial scene
Fixed problem with subtitles in all levels
Fixed speed of repairer ship in last levels
Fixed speed of laser shooting of repairer in last levels
Fixed playing start speed after pause in all levels
Fixed EMP-gun shooting sound
Fixed subtitles after EMP-gun activation


Big thanks, dear friends, for your reviews and comments! We really need to know your opinion about the game to improve this and we are on the right way thanks to you.

Best regards, Immergity Team
